caption: The drawing shows a mortar and pestle set, depicted in realistic detail. The mortar is cylindrical with a wide, slightly flared rim and a sturdy, thick base. It has a series of horizontal ridges running around its body. Both the mortar and pestle are colored in shades of brown, with the surface texture suggesting they are made of wood. The pestle is inside the mortar, oriented at an angle, with the thicker rounded end visible at the top and the thinner handle end submerged in the bowl. The overall background of the drawing is a plain, light beige color, free of any additional objects or patterns. The name "Carl Buergerniss." is handwritten near the bottom right corner of the image.
title: Mortar and Pestle
